resources.string:
Your charts, records and settings stay on your phone. What leaves it:

• Ranking: your name, your best scores and an anonymous code for your phone go to a spreadsheet owned by the developer of Riff and are shown in the ranking to everyone.
• Report: the text, the email (if you add one) and, if left on, the device information go to the developer.
• Spotify: Riff reads the playing song and your queue straight from Spotify; none of it goes to the developer.
• Chart search: searches and downloads go to Encore (enchor.us).

To remove your name and scores from the ranking, ask through Report.
